Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: we're publishing a clarified handbook paragraph for bereavement & compassionate leave that includes cross-border notes (country minimums + examples). Scheduling short manager microtraining next week to walk through documentation expectations and sign-off flow. RSVP here: https://sheets.redwood.ai/s/bereavement-crossborder :calendar:

Priya (People Ops): Two live sessions to cover APAC/EMEA/US windows: Mon 08:00 PT (EMEA-friendly) and Wed 17:00 PT (APAC-friendly). Each session 30m + Q&A. Please add headcount in the sheet.

Zoe (Payroll): Quick payroll ask: what deadline should managers use for submitting docs to avoid mid-cycle exceptions? we need a hard cutoff to auto-ingest.

Maya (People Ops): Good point. Docs must be attached within 5 business days of return-to-work or payroll will flag for manual review. We'll add that to the handbook text.

Nina (Legal): Note: in X country the law requires paid bereavement for immediate family up to 3 days, cannot be less. handbook language must not reduce statutory rights. I'll review the localized snippets.

Diego (EMEA): can we include guidance for extended family recognition in regions where family structures differ? some EMEA countries allow more generous employer policies.

Maya (People Ops): yes  we'll add an appendix per region: statutory minimums + company standard examples. Not changing company-wide eligibility, just documenting regional allowances.

Alex (IC): if a manager approves 2 days now and later changes to 5 (retro), how should payroll and benefits be updated? i've seen messy retro approvals.

Sam (HR): retroactive increases ok but require manager note + HR approval in the HRIS. payroll will accept CSV with an 'adjustment' flag to process retro pay.

Zoe (Payroll): CSV header we'll accept for auto-ingest (please use exact column names):

```
emp_id, emp_email, country_code, leave_type, start_date, end_date, pay_status, docs_attached (Y/N), manager_approval_ts, adjustment_flag (Y/N), payroll_period
```

people-ops-bot: RSVP reminder set  sheet closes 48h before first session.

Priya (People Ops): action items: 1) managers add names/headcounts by EOD Fri; 2) Priya to publish 1-slide FAQ and a 90s clip after each session; 3) Nina to drop country exceptions list; 4) Zoe to confirm CSV ingest schedule with payroll ops.

Diego (EMEA): will coordinate translation for FR/DE/ES snippets and post in the regional HR folder.

Maya (People Ops): thanks all. we'll push the handbook patch after the sessions and include a changelog entry. linking draft for review: https://docs.redwood.ai/handbook/bereavement-crossborder-draft :link:
